invariant: Same known failure class should fail fast before expensive qualification.

prevention: explicitly initialize newly added aggregate fields
CMake promotes supported missing-field initializer warnings to errors

classes.symptom: -Wrange-loop-construct copies std::string values in hot/evaluation loops
prevention: bind stable loop values by const reference
CMake promotes supported range-loop warnings to errors

classes.symptom: Lean ext tactic cannot prove Vec3 coordinate equality
prevention: register Vec3.ext_coords with @[ext]
keep exact geometry extensionality in the foundational Exact module

classes.symptom: positivity fails to establish nonnegativity of dot a a after unfolding
prevention: use explicit sq_nonneg hypotheses and nlinarith

classes.symptom: ssh -A railway.new does not expose forwarded agent inside Railway relay
prevention: perform deploy-key Git operations on dispatcher
send Railway source bundles without GitHub credentials

classes.symptom: Railway provisioning JSON can emit a one-time human_claim_url into Actions logs
prevention: filter human_claim_url lines in Railway SSH workflow output

classes.symptom: CACE OCI runner lacks CMake/Ninja but has persistent Lean infrastructure
prevention: treat CACE OCI as formal/static ARM64 lane
make C++ optional on that runner
use Avrea for C++/benchmarks

classes.symptom: self-hosted qualification job executes candidate code while holding repository write authority
prevention: self-hosted qualification job has contents: read only
checkout uses persist-credentials: false
result is uploaded as an artifact
separate GitHub-hosted publisher job holds contents: write and never executes candidate code

classes.symptom: formal build keeps Mathlib pinned but silently adds or changes another Lake dependency
prevention: lock the complete Lake package graph by name/type/url/rev/inputRev
reject executable lakefile.lean
allow only reviewed Lean/Mathlib upstream repository prefixes

classes.symptom: Expert Robot dispatches work to an unpinned CACE commit, unknown capability, or mismatched execution lane.
prevention: pin the exact Cace-app commit from a successful capability probe
dispatch only allowlisted capability IDs and lanes
reject request budgets above per-capability maxima

classes.symptom: Returned CACE evidence does not bind exactly to the original request/source/CACE commit or its canonical result hash.
prevention: require exact request/source/CACE/capability bindings
require SHA-256 evidence and canonical result digests
reject runtime usage above the admitted request budget

classes.symptom: External CACE results attempt to carry promotion authority, automatic promotion, or non-free resource status.
prevention: fix CACE authority to qualification-only
force promotion_authority false and automatic promotion false
require monetary_cost free and preserve the existing external promotion boundary

classes.symptom: A passing external CACE verifier result is accidentally treated as a keep recommendation or promotion approval.
prevention: record CACE results as non-recommending generation evaluations
force recommend_keep false for CACE evidence
keep hidden ablation evidence and external promotion approval as independent gates

classes.symptom: A candidate is sent to a verifier lane that cannot check it, or expensive Avrea work is used when a bounded CACE capability is sufficient.
prevention: route only through the CACE capability allowlist
keep C++/model/runtime changes on Avrea rather than the ARM64 formal CACE lane
use deterministic path-based routing and validate every emitted CACE request against the broker contract

classes.symptom: A generation has an admitted required CACE verification request but can still become promotable before any passing evidence is returned.
prevention: record the admitted CACE request as a required failing gate before execution
treat the latest result for each required gate as authoritative gate state
block promotion while a required gate is missing or failed without treating verifier evidence as a keep recommendation
